permissions: Existing P12 per-owner permission, confirmed session warehouse, current warehouse ACL and tenant scope; no new grant
intent_source: mini_app_web_post_handoffs written atomically by successful P04 inbound/P05 outbound RECORD, including source-linked P05
current_source: Exact canonical stock_documents type/directional warehouse/nondeleted row and current status
waiting_rule: Persisted handoff exists AND canonical DRAFT/SCANNING. Never infer membership from SCANNING/readiness/notification/historical receipt alone.
terminal_rule: POSTED/CANCELLED remove current queue membership; immutable submission intent remains
warranty: Not a stock POST operation; zero queue membership
legacy: No backfill; missing intent remains NOT_ESTABLISHED/null, not proof of never submitted

projection.private_receipt: Historical record_handoff stays scoped to current actor/family; current handoff is warehouse-readable
projection.submitted_at: RFC3339 UTC Z server transactional write time, not WAL commit/delivery time
projection.posted_at: Exact nullable stock_documents.posted_at using document-timestamps-v1, never inferred from POSTED
projection.read_target: Existing P12 canonical business owner target, not draft/recipient/receipt

query.totals: Filter before facets/source/cursor; counts cover the whole authorized filtered set
query.paging_sort_date: Same P12 keyset v3, created_at date/sort, rank/id tie break and Vietnam date query; not submitted_at sort
query.consistency: Single-response snapshot, live state/counts between requests, not a frozen queue
query.cursor: Includes web_queue; old/filter-changed cursor can return 409 DOCUMENTS_CURSOR_CONTEXT_CHANGED; restart cursor=start preserving filters
query.unfiltered_legacy: Does not require the new table; optional handoff remains null

rollout: Review/apply additive schema before new RECORD code; not permission to migrate/deploy real DB
